notes.title: Patch v0.8 – "Cool" New Update!
notes.content: [h1]Patch v0.8 – "Cool" New Update![/h1][h3]New Abilities[/h3][list]    [*][b]Wall Running[/b] – Run along walls and chain wall jumps![/*]    [*][b]Swimming[/b] – Water is no longer an obstacle.[/*]    [*][b]Coin Magnet[/b] – Collect coins effortlessly.[/*][/list][h3]New Content[/h3][list]    [*][b]Snow & Ice Levels revamped[/b] with improved details and design:[list]            [*][b]Deeper snow and snowmen[/b] enhance the winter atmosphere.[/*]            [*][b]New winter hat[/b] for a fitting look.[/*]            [*][b]Ice spikes[/b] – Watch out, they hurt![/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Chests, vases, and barrels[/b] now drop coins with improved effects.[/*]    [*][b]New animals:[/b] Chickens, sheep, and fish have been added.[/*]    [*][b]Canyon Level expanded[/b] with a new puzzle.[/*]    [*][b]More structures and collectibles[/b] in the Castle Courtyard level.[/*]    [*][b]Castle Tower Level expanded[/b] and decorated. notes.title: Big Update! Version 0.6 is now online!
notes.content:
Pecker is getting bigger! New skills, new skins, new music, new bug-fixes, a new language, a store to spend these shiny in-game coins, and the most important thing: NEW HATS!With version 0.6. we are taking a big step towards the finished game. Thanks to everyone who played the demo, supported the Early Access and all your feedback!

Here are the detailed patch notes:

[h1]New Content[/h1]    [list]        [*][b]Vending Machine "Shop":[/b] A new vending machine has been added where players can purchase abilities.[/*]        [*][b]Added Ability 'Forward Dash':[/b] A new dash move allows players to quickly move forward.[/*]        [*][b]Added Ability 'Net Climbing':[/b] Players can now climb nets as a new mobility option.[/*]        [*][b]Added Twitch Integration:[/b] Streamers can now connect their twitch account, so viewers can trigger events in the game like spawning sheep or letting money rain.[/*]        [*][b]Hat-Insurance:[/b] Hats will return to you after falling into the void.[/*]        [*][b]Zuckerwatte Hats:[/b] Added fluffy new Zuckerwatte hats for players to wear.[/*]        [*][b]Spice Pot:[/b] A new interactive object, the spice pot, has been added.[/*]        [*][b]New Skin:[/b] Introduced a new black-green skin for player customization.[/*]        [*][b]New Skin:[/b] Introduced a fluffy new skin inspired by Appa.[/*]    [/list]  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774414/809b8cd37d2a6e7d0df6c2be5ea901f66bc34011.gif[/img]  [h2]Audio and Music[/h2]    [list]        [*][b]Level Music:[/b] Music has been added to the following levels, completing the list for now:            [list]                [*]Castle Yard[/*]                [*]Castle Tower[/*]                [*]Ice Mountain[/*]                [*]Snow Slide[/*]                [*]Forest[/*]                [*]Canyon[/*]            [/list]        [/*]        [*][b]Trumpet Sound:[/b] Added a fun trumpet sound when using the golden climb-helper.[/*]    [/list]    [h2]Localization[/h2]    [list]        [*][b]Portuguese (Brazil):[/b] Added full support for the Brazilian Portuguese language.[/*]    [/list]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774414/2c43894351903f2f8cd12a7e5e5a6befd800b4db.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774414/2c43894351903f2f8cd12a7e5e5a6befd800b4db.gif[/img][/url]  [h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]    [list]        [*][b]Improved Combat Animations:[/b] Players and enemies show more feedback during combat.[/*]        [*][b]Enemy Healthbars:[/b] Now visible for better combat feedback.[/*]        [*][b]Fixed Enemy AI:[/b] Resolved issue where enemies would get stuck; added ragdoll effect upon defeat.[/*]        [*][b]Destructible Objects:[/b] Objects now show visible cracks when damaged, with added dust effects when breaking.[/*]        [*][b]Camera Adjustments:[/b]            [list]                [*]Camera no longer clips into the ground.[/*]                [*]Players turn transparent when too close to the camera, preventing the unsettling "creepy eyes" effect.[/*]                [*]Improved tree dithering when the camera moves inside trees for better visual clarity.[/*]                [*]Grass now becomes semi-transparent when looking upwards, improving visibility.[/*]            [/list]        [/*]        [*][b]Swimming Improvements:[/b] Swimming mechanics have been fine-tuned for smoother control and responsiveness (no longer floating above water).[/*]        [*][b]Increased Falldamage Height:[/b] Adjusted the fall damage threshold, so players can fall from higher distances without getting hurt.[/*]    [/list]    [h2]Combat & Interaction Enhancements[/h2]    [list]        [*][b]Multi-object Slicing:[/b] You can now hit multiple objects with a single slice.[/*]        [*][b]Player-Player Damage:[/b] Fixed player-on-player damage; when hit, players will now drop (half of) their hats/fruit.[/*]        [*][b]Idle Animations:[/b] Idle animations no longer trigger notes.title: Update Ver. 0.5.51 Now Live!
notes.content:
Winged friends!
Our first update after the Early Access brings numerous small and large additions to the game. Thank you very much for your feedback and great support!

Here are the detailed patch notes:

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
- Added 3 New Achievements: Collect 100 silver coins (with progress), discover a secret area, collect a golden plank.

[h3]Physics:[/h3]
- Boxes in Cardboard Land now push you away properly
- Fixed Explosive Barrel throwing you too far
- Fog in CastleTower level had a collider by accident, removed that.
- Fixed rarely being able to run on very steep surfaces that should only be used for climbing
- Added a walljump mechanic (a single jump, resets when you touch ground)

[h3]Performance:[/h3]
- Speedrun overlay Performance Improvement, no garbage collection and skips work when not visible, but updating time (but not text)
- Grass System Performance Improvement (less Garbage Collection & reusing ComputerBuffers)
- Adjustments to Shadows to improve Performance

[h3]Collectibles:[/h3]
- GoldPlank and Secret Areas now have Celebration Sound, Golden Plank got Particle Effect
- Enhanced "Inventory" Coins display font
- Created Level-End-Screen with nice background and statistics, showing stuff you collected and how many jumps/pecks you used etc.
- Created a new UI transition between levels

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774414/b53ae10e0f88ed15d79ea59726ab7f7c34287293.gif[/img]

[h3]Music&Sounds:[/h3]
- Fixed Music Loop in level 1
- Fixed UI Sounds being muted after pausing the game for the first time
- Added more dynamic Music Adaption (Moods) to level 1
- Added Music to level 2
- Added music to main menu

[h3]Animation:[/h3]
- Fixed eyes sticking out of peckers back for one frame when pecking into a surface
- Fixed eyelid color on skins (for example orange eyelids on blue skin)

[h3]Combat:[/h3]
- Disabled Enemy-Locking (ALT or R3) because it flickered and isn't ready yet, will be reintroduced when combat is overhauled
- Fixed enemy knockback, as it could push enemies into the ground
- Added skull icon when you defeat an enemy, as the "dying" animation itself didn't look very convincing
- Enemies now *poof* away after being defeated. Before, they could block coins or entries with their immovable body

[h3] Haptics:[/h3]
- Improved Controller Vibration, Controller1 no longer vibrates when P2 (or any) Player should vibrate. 
- Added Vibration to death effect

[h3]Graphics:[/h3]
- Fixed Crossfading on Ivy
- Re-painted the path in level 2 because the mesh got changed and the vertex colors were gone

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
- Hats no longer score goals in the soccer minigame, items no longer score multiple points

[h3]Translations:[/h3]
- Added various translations, also for Lockpicking tutorial (Thanks to zuckerwattem)

Enjoy the improvements and stay tuned: We are already working on the next update!

notes.title: Splitscreen, Hearts, Smart Camera!
notes.content:
New Features:
- Splitscreen (coop)
- Hearts ♥♥♥
- Smart Camera (can be disabled via options->advanced)

Fixed:
- A bug that allowed you to poke yourself which caused unwanted flying
- Dialog Button was at wrong position
- Menu could get stuck when loading a level
- coins didn't reset (visually, was fixed once you collect a new one) when restarting the demo
- "Space" instead of "(A)" shown when using Controller
- Graphics Settings: Volumetric Fog "medium" was actually "high", expect better performance on medium now.
- Player2 got a screenshake when Player1 died.
- Speedrun timer was broken, didn't reset when a new level started. 
- dying multiple times caused players to respawn at world-origin. 
- cutting grass now actually cut's a "pizza slice" instead of a full circle

Improvements:
- Camera fades in faster when obscured 
- Haystacks no longer destroy barrels and vases (soft landing!)
- "Start" Button now closes the menu just like ESC does
- Adjustments to camera rotation when running left/right from camera
- Camera rotation (when running) now respects user rotation cooldown (when you manually turn the camera, the game won't intefere!) 
- collected P-E-C-K-E-R letters are now shown WITH their outline so it's easier to see which ones are collected or not
- Ivy now supports crossfade (smoother transition when blending in/out)
- red barrel now has a proper explosion sound
- flying platforms got particle effects and are bouncy now!

notes.title: Technical Update
notes.content:
[h1]Big technical update![/h1]

♦ Improved camera collision with smart wall avoidance, able to go around corners!
[b]+[/b] Added [b]DLSS/FSR[/b] options to improve performance on lower end hardware like the steamdeck.

Added options for:
♦ Texture-, Shadow- and Objectquality
♦ Ambient Occlusion
♦ Bloom
♦ Volumetric Fog
♦ Grass quality & render distance

[b]+[/b] Added [b]Shader-Warmup[/b] code to the loading screens to avoid stutters in the beginning.
[b]+[/b] Pecker is now able to squash and stretch to appear more bouncy and dynamic.

Other Changes:
♦ Won't ask for anonmyous data collection twice
[b]+[/b] Added Turtle Merchant with overhauled Dialog Ui
[b]+[/b] Added Music to demo-levels 2 and 3. 
♦ Fixed bell sound at the end of the demo
♦ Fixed Hat orientation when preparing the catapult for launch
[b]+[/b] Added more hats.
